## License Compliance

All images used in this project are:
1. **Public Domain**: US Government works (US Navy images)
2. **Pixabay License**: Free for commercial use without attribution (preferred for ease of use)
3. **CC0 Public Domain**: Creative Commons Zero dedication

## Usage Notes

For the hackathon demonstration:
- Images are used for safety hazard detection testing
- No commercial use beyond demonstration purposes
- Attribution provided where applicable
- All licenses permit modification and analysis

## Image Download Instructions

Due to file size constraints, some images require manual download:

1. Visit the URLs listed above
2. Download the full-resolution images
3. Save to `packages/core/test/fixtures/scenarios/`
4. Use the filenames listed in this document

## Alternative Sources

If any URLs are unavailable, suitable alternatives can be found at:
- Pixabay: https://pixabay.com/images/search/construction%20safety/
- Unsplash: https://unsplash.com/s/photos/construction-safety
